# ToBoolean

Converts a value to a boolean by the language's truthiness rule.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
ToBoolean(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | any | The value to convert. Any value, null included. |

## Returns

Boolean. False for null, false, the number zero and the empty string; true for every other value, an empty array, an empty object and a function included. Never null.

## Example

`ToBoolean("")` returns false.

`ToBoolean([])` returns true.
